meaning_first.independence_note: Fresh reviewer context, separate from the author. meaning.situation_summary: An older woman with a white bun and blue cardigan hands Mo, a young man, a plain yellow mug at a small birthday; a cake and wrapping paper are on the table.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Name the gift Mo receives (a mug) and who gives it (his grandmother, shown as much older), two facts a beginner can say in one short sentence each.
meaning.contrivance_check: The mug is an ordinary gift, held out by one person to another, so 'what' and 'who' are both visible in the same act. The only inference is 'oma' from age and the cake; 'een vrouw' is accepted, so no hidden knowledge decides the goal.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: The learner describes the drawing aloud as speaking practice; nobody is addressed on the page, so no recipient has to be invented. With the friend's phone call removed there is no missed party to explain.
